about.title: About the Project
about.desc: Children with dyslalia lose interest in routine speech therapy sessions. Our game turns articulation exercises, sound production, and automation into an exciting adventure.

tip1.title: Don't ignore mistakes
tip1.desc: If a sound is pronounced incorrectly — the task doesn't count. Only correct pronunciation leads to victory!

tip2.title: Use the mirror
tip2.desc: Show the correct articulation and ask the child to watch themselves. Visual control is the key to success.

tip3.title: Regularity
tip3.desc: Play 2-3 times a week for 15-20 minutes. Short but regular sessions give the best results.

effects.title: Expected Effects
effects.1: Increased motivation for speech therapy sessions
effects.3: Faster automation of sounds in a game environment
effects.4: Development of fine and gross motor skills stimulating speech
effects.5: Parental involvement in the correction process
